summary: Bearer is unaffected by Verbal Magical abilities used from beyond Touch, harmful or beneficial; (ex) and Touch-range uses still work.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Not (ex) abilities, abilities with a Range of Touch, or longer-range abilities used at Touch range.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Drawback: beneficial Verbal Magical abilities used from beyond Touch also have no effect on the bearer.

clarifications.text: Blocks beneficial as well as harmful Magical abilities.
Does not affect (ex) abilities, abilities with a Range of Touch, or abilities with a longer Range that are used at Touch range.
